title: onboard-novus-13b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Maya Chen
description: Onboard Novus 13B v1.0: add model metadata, performance profiles and wire up changelog/release note automation. This PR adds a new model entry (novus-13b v1.0) to the registry with validated metadata, generates per-hardware performance profiles (A100-40GB, H100-80GB, T4), and integrates the automated changelog generation pipeline so model onboarding triggers a release note draft. Motivation: Novus is a community model we want to offer as a verified option in the catalog with reproducible perf characteristics and automated release notes to reduce manual ops. Changes include: 1) metadata JSON for novus including architecture, tokenizer, artifacts with checksums, provenance and recommended quantization profiles; 2) perf profile JSON with latency/throughput matrices and SLO guidance derived from benchmark-lab runs; 3) an automated changelog hook that collects registry diffs and formats release notes (scripts/auto_changelog.py) and a small Console docs page; 4) tests and CI scaffolding that validate schema and profile sanity. Testing: unit tests for metadata schema, integration bench runs pushed to perf-bench CI artifact, manual verification on dedicated infra. Rollout: added canary tags so hosted catalog will show novus-v1.0 as beta until a 7-day observability window passes. See linked Linear items for rollout checklist and PM acceptance criteria.
